items.title: Deploy Amazon WorkSpaces across Regions with Entra ID and IAM Identity Center
items.summary: Organizations with a globally distributed workforce often need to deploy Amazon WorkSpaces Personal across multiple AWS Regions while maintaining centralized identity management with Microsoft Entra ID (formerly Azure Active Directory). Until recently, this required a tradeoff: either a single AWS IAM Identity Center instance with cross-Region calls at runtime, or separate Identity Center instances per […]
